visualInspection.presentationNotes: The full-resolution diagnostic is materially clearer than the embedded Kaminos image plane, but the exercised viewer route remains legible and correctly registers the image as a scene object.
visualInspection.limitations: This is a corresponding-vertex truth-fixture visualization. The observed normals are authored-carrier normals, and the sparse ribbed point pattern reflects fixture sampling rather than fur strand structure.
